# ContextIQ

Engineer your AI's context, visually. ContextIQ is a suite of 11 live tools for AI engineers, free on the public tools with no sign-up:

- Token Inspector, compare token counts and costs across GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini and 20+ models before you commit.
- AI Agent Protocol Inspector, scan any URL for MCP, A2A and ARD support, with live handshake and agent-card checks.
- RAG Chunk Inspector, see exactly how documents split into chunks across strategies, with a live LLM context preview.
- Agent Workflow Visualizer, paste a GitHub URL and see your agent graph (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK).
- Agent Trace Inspector, Memory Architecture Visualizer, HyDE Visualizer, OIDC Inspector, DNS Inspector, x402 Inspector, ERC-8004 Inspector, plus a Pro Agent Commerce Gate.

Free to use; $5/month Pro unlocks PNG/SVG/PDF exports and shared links. Listed from the public site (contextiq.trango-compute.com), not tested by Skill Harbor. Review before relying on it, as always.
